integrity: A self-contained mathematical proof and reproducible exact symbolic checker are included. Numerical eigenvalues illustrate, but do not establish, the global classification.
scientific_limitations: Does not classify the full Liouvillian, memory-backflow measures or nonlinear/multimode systems; the original EP3 coordinates and numerical EP curves are prior results; equivalent analytic calculations outside checked sources remain a possibility.
scope: Strictly positive coherent coupling, linewidth and reservoir coupling; the exactly printed three-by-three pseudomode amplitude Hamiltonian.
title: Reentrant nonoscillatory window and a sharp \(3/2\)-cusp in a Lorentzian pseudomode trimer
